proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hE := t.excenterExists_singleton i
  have pyth : ∀ x l : Fin 3, x ≠ l → dist (t.points x) (t.touchpoint {i} l) ^ 2 = dist (t.points x) (t.excenter {i}) ^ 2 - t.exradius {i} ^ 2 := by
    intro x l hxl
    have h1 : inner ℝ (t.points x -ᵥ t.touchpoint {i} l) (t.touchpoint {i} l -ᵥ t.excenter {i}) = 0 :=
      (hE.isTangentAt_touchpoint l).inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem (t.points_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite.2 hxl)
    have h2 : t.points x -ᵥ t.excenter {i} = (t.points x -ᵥ t.touchpoint {i} l) + (t.touchpoint {i} l -ᵥ t.excenter {i}) := (vsub_add_vsub_cancel _ _ _).symm
    have h3 : ‖t.touchpoint {i} l -ᵥ t.excenter {i}‖ = t.exradius {i} := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub, dist_comm]; exact hE.dist_excenter l
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V (t.points x) (t.excenter {i}), h2, norm_add_sq_real, h1, h3, dist_eq_norm_vsub V (t.points x) (t.touchpoint {i} l)]
    ring
  have eqt : ∀ x l m : Fin 3, x ≠ l → x ≠ m → dist (t.points x) (t.touchpoint {i} l) = dist (t.points x) (t.touchpoint {i} m) := by
    intro x l m hl hm
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg, pyth x l hl, pyth x m hm]
  have s1 := (t.sbtw_touchpoint_singleton hij.symm hjk hik).wbtw.dist_add_dist
  have s2 := (t.touchpoint_singleton_sbtw hij hik hjk).wbtw.dist_add_dist
  have s3 := (t.touchpoint_singleton_sbtw hik hij hjk.symm).wbtw.dist_add_dist
  have e1 := eqt i j k hij hik
  have e2 := eqt j k i hjk hij.symm
  have e3 := eqt k j i hjk.symm hik.symm
  rw [dist_comm (t.touchpoint {i} i) (t.points k)] at s1
  rw [dist_comm (t.touchpoint {i} j) (t.points k), dist_comm (t.touchpoint {i} j) (t.points i), dist_comm (t.points k) (t.points i)] at s2
  rw [dist_comm (t.touchpoint {i} k) (t.points j), dist_comm (t.touchpoint {i} k) (t.points i), dist_comm (t.points j) (t.points i)] at s3
  refine ⟨e1, ?_⟩
  rw [dist_comm (t.points k) (t.points i)]
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist (t.points i) (t.touchpoint {i} j) = dist (t.points i) (t.touchpoint {i} k) ∧ dist (t.points i) (t.touchpoint {i} j) = (dist (t.points i) (t.points j) + dist (t.points j) (t.points k) + dist (t.points k) (t.points i)) / 2
